from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents the extracted financial data for a single company from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the report")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock security code if available in the report")
    total_profit: float | None = Field(description="The reported 'Total Profit' (利润总额) amount in yuan")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period mentioned in the document (e.g., 2024 Q1)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profit_records: list[CompanyProfitRecord]
